thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: p99 latency spike observed for customer Calypso Maritime (VPC: calypso-eu1) starting 1758246789. p99 ~ 4.8s, baseline p99 300ms. Impact: API throughput degraded for dedicated pool. Auto-escalation to oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: @here taking this. grabbing logs and load metrics.
alex_nguyen: seeing a persistent tail on the renderer nodes in eu-west-1 dedicated pool. KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% to 60% around 17:06UTC.
priya_shah: confirming, traffic shows sudden burst of large long-context chats from a subset of tenant IDs. suspect noisy tenant session.
emily_wu: customer-reported errors? marta, any comms from Calypso?
marta_support: Calypso support channel says degraded latency for navigation assistant, no 5xxs reported from client side yet. They're waiting for ETA. asked to prioritize.
alex_nguyen: running quick check: `redwoodctl pool top --pool calypso-eu1` shows 1 host hitting >90% GPU mem, multiple hosts at high latency.
sam_ops: recommend isolating suspect tenant IDs and routing them to a warm spare pool while we investigate. we have warm spare in eu-west-1 set to 2 nodes idle.
oncall-sre: agreed. @lucas_platform can you trigger tenant isolation and warm-spare routing? add canary sampling to verify quality.
lucas_platform: running routing change: `redwoodctl routing isolate-tenant --vpc calypso-eu1 --tenant 0xAC3F --to-pool calypso-warm-spare` now. patch in progress, ETA ~90s.
incident-bot: routing change applied by lucas_platform at 1758246890.
priya_shah: after isolation, p99 dropped to 1.2s (17:08UTC) — still above SLO but much improved. CPU/GPU pressure reduced on primary pool.
emily_wu: good. let's scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes to return capacity to normal while we trace root cause. command: `redwoodctl pool scale --pool calypso-eu1 --replicas +2`
lucas_platform: scale started, provisioning new instances.
alex_nguyen: pulling model-run logs, noticing frequent long-context requests with seq_len > 10k, KV cache miss patterns. suspect client started a background replay job.
calypso-sre: (customer) we've deployed a batch replay job accidentally to prod; shutting it down now. will confirm in 60s.
marta_support: customer confirms stopping batch job, will follow up with TKT-9876 for RCA.
oncall-sre: monitoring. if p99 remains >1.0s after scale up and isolation, we will evict tenant as last resort and cut traffic to dedicated pool until patch.
sam_ops: eviction readiness: `redwoodctl tenant evict --vpc calypso-eu1 --tenant 0xAC3F --force` will gracefully drain sessions and failover KV state to fallback. Need approval.
priya_shah: approve eviction if customer doesn't stop job in next 2 minutes.
emily_wu: prepare customer message draft. marta_support, ready to send if we evict: "Calypso — we're isolating heavy workload impacting latency; short disruption likely while we migrate sessions to spare pool. ETA ~5m."
marta_support: ready.
incident-bot: metric update: 17:09UTC p99=900ms, p95=220ms.
oncall-sre: good trending down. cancel eviction for now. keep isolation and scale in place. Lucas, keep warm-spare routing for 10m then revert.
lucas_platform: will monitor and revert after 10m if stable.
calypso-sre: thank you team. we've stopped the batch, seeing client-side latency go back to normal. appreciate rapid response.
alex_nguyen: creating quick mitigation notes in runbook: added tenant isolation step and warm-spare routing commands, flagged as temp playbook entry.
sam_ops: logging incident in PagerDuty as follow-up required for policy: add guardrails to prevent replay jobs from targeting prod dedicated pools.
emily_wu: taking action item: coordinate postmortem and customer follow-up. owner: emily_wu.
priya_shah: add metric alert tweak: threshold for KV cache drop to 70% in dedicated pools. owner: priya_shah.
marta_support: sent customer ack and updated support ticket.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to `mitigated` at 1758246980 — p99 sustained < 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes. will monitor for regression.
oncall-sre: closing war room. folks please keep notes in #postmortems and link TKT-9876. great job. :thumbsup:
